name: Canary Mail
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Canary Mail, build a privacy-conscious desktop email client with local indexing and optional summaries. The hard boundary is cross-platform clients, push, encryption features, provider support, and ai polish, plus mail infrastructure, integrations, and client polish.
